<thought>Based on the observed isotopic peak series spaced by ~1.003 Da and the relative intensities (≈10 % for M+1, ≈1 % for M+2, etc.), the pattern matches the natural 13C distribution of a carbon‑containing molecule. No characteristic Cl, Br, S, Si, or other element isotope signatures are present. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the spectrum.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
